label: A Nayuta Like No Other: A

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: How doth the situation fare?

lines.speaker: johan
lines.text: Isn't it obvious? The Queen is bombarding Eden with her beam.
*Bang!* *Boom!*

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: Is all well with Eden?

lines.speaker: johan
lines.text: The shield over all of Eden is holding. Not all attacks are blocked, but it's sufficiently effective.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: ... So, it doth pale before that savage beam of yore.

lines.speaker: johan
lines.text: Right. That means Eden's Spear and Marian Can—Marian's counterstrike were effective.

lines.speaker: johan
lines.text: The Queen can't use her large-caliber beam for now.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: Perchance she doth restrain herself, mindful of Young Lady Marian's counterstrike.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: Therefore, she chooseth not a single mighty blow, but many lesser ones.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: In either case, 'tis certain the Queen seeketh to curb our movements.
*Bang!* *Boom!*

lines.speaker: johan
lines.text: So it seems that your observation that the Queen is afraid may be correct.

lines.speaker: johan
lines.text: Even with her overwhelming forces and power, she still restrains herself.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: Let us advance.

lines.speaker: johan
lines.text: How many clones remain?

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: Verily, those who survived the recent defensive battle number 1,180.

lines.speaker: johan
lines.text: ... This is doable.

lines.speaker: johan
lines.text: Indivilia and Chatterbox can be countered by Inherit, Pioneer, and White Knight.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: Verily, should our special forces confront theirs, and the lesser foes be entrusted unto mine replicas.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: ... Thus shall we reach the place where the Queen abideth.
*Bang!* *Boom!*

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: The problem, verily, lieth in how shall we draw the Queen within our grasp...

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: Are the chains by which we erstwhile dragged down the White Giant no longer serviceable?

lines.speaker: johan
lines.text: She's out of range. No doubt she accounted for that when choosing her drop point.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: ... So it is, she is afeard—
*Bang!* *Boom!*

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: She doth fire most vigorously, verily.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: When shall Young Lady Isabel return from her scouting?

lines.speaker: johan
lines.text: She will be back soon.

lines.speaker: cecil_op_r
lines.text: Isabel is falling your way.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: ... What sayest thou?
*Whoooosh*
*Boom!*
Isabel plummets onto the runway with a loud crash.

lines.speaker: isabel
lines.text: Ugh...! Comman... der...!

lines.speaker: johan
lines.text: How bad is the damage?

lines.speaker: isabel
lines.text: I'm... fine. Just lost two feathers.
Isabel struggles to get up.

lines.speaker: isabel
lines.text: Whew...

lines.speaker: johan
lines.text: Did you get hit by the beam?
10 minutes ago.
Isabel flies through the air, dodging the Queen's continuous stream of beams.
There are many of them, but their trajectory and timing are consistent.

lines.speaker: isabel
lines.text: ... These are just to keep us in check.

lines.speaker: isabel
lines.text: The problem is...
Isabel rolls to evade another beam.
Far ahead, the Queen looms in the distance.
Below her, Raptures press in tight, shoulder to shoulder.
And still they come, pouring in ceaselessly from the distant edges of the battlefield.

lines.speaker: isabel
lines.text: ... There're just too many.
Isabel looks to the Queen once more.
Dozens of thick cables snake from her body, trailing upward and vanishing into the clouds above.
Curiosity grips her—she wants to know what those wires are connected to.
She ascends. Her sensors flare with warnings, her temperature and pressure readings in chaos.
But she has time. Just enough.
Isabel surges upward, breaking through the clouds.

lines.speaker: isabel
lines.text: ... What's this?
A massive black object is tethered to the Queen by thick, winding cables.
Its purpose is unclear. It's just a dark, hulking mass with no discernible form.
From two open cavities, smoke curls upward, lit by bursts of erratic sparks.

lines.speaker: isabel
lines.text: ... Are those from Eden's Spear and Marian Cannon...?

lines.speaker: isabel
lines.text: Then this must be...
The black mass opens its eyes,
or at least, that's how it feels to Isabel.
Dozens of glowing red cores reveal themselves across its surface.
Instinct takes over. She whips her body around
just as the cores begin to fire in unison.
A beam grazes her, instantly melting one of her feathers to vapor.

lines.speaker: isabel
lines.text: Argh...!
She drops altitude, weaving through the deadly rain of beams.
Heat sensors blare nonstop, but they mean nothing now.
Reflex takes over. She dodges on instinct alone, accelerating with everything she's got.

lines.speaker: isabel
lines.text: ... The shape has changed a lot, but that was definitely the space station. I'm sure of it.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: ... Art thou speaking of the orbital forge?

lines.speaker: isabel
lines.text: Yes.

lines.speaker: isabel
lines.text: The Queen is currently linked to it,

lines.speaker: isabel
lines.text: and the space station's been retrofitted as a fortress.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: ... She hath descended with the orbital forge still whole...

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: and wrought it into a fortress... Verily, such prodigious firepower is thus accounted for.

lines.speaker: isabel
lines.text: The fortress looks badly damaged, but it's holding its altitude just fine.

lines.speaker: isabel
lines.text: It's packed with multiple automated interception weapons.

lines.speaker: isabel
lines.text: The moment I got too close, it started firing beams.

lines.speaker: isabel
lines.text: I managed to dodge and pull back, but there's no way I can take it on alone.

lines.speaker: isabel
lines.text: I'm not sure how far those weapons reach, but they can easily hit the surface.

lines.speaker: johan
lines.text: This is vexing.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: Verily, she doth pursue naught but the safest course.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: Should the Queen unleash her full force, or any other stratagem of aggression, perchance we might catch her unawares.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: Yet she maketh full use of her advantage, restraining herself all the same. Most vexing, verily.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: Should we allow this affair to linger, defeat shall befall us. She shall continue her convalescence and gather Raptures, whilst we...

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: ... must needs bring this matter to a close with all haste...

lines.speaker: johan
lines.text: ... Monk.

lines.speaker: johan
lines.text: Are all your clones sentient?

lines.speaker: johan
lines.text: Enough. Say no more.

lines.speaker: johan
lines.text: Everyone, gather.

lines.speaker: johan
lines.text: Here is the current situation:

lines.speaker: johan
lines.text: Part of the space station is confirmed to be linked to the Queen.

lines.speaker: johan
lines.text: It is concealed above the clouds and has been remodeled into a fortress.

lines.speaker: johan
lines.text: Any attempt to approach is met with automated interception fire.

lines.speaker: johan
lines.text: Its range easily reaches the surface, though not Eden.

lines.speaker: johan
lines.text: The Queen has fortified her position to block all access while she gathers Raptures.

lines.speaker: johan
lines.text: Once she deems their numbers sufficient, she will launch her offensive.

lines.speaker: johan
lines.text: Furthermore, as you all know—
*Bang!* *Boom!*

lines.speaker: johan
lines.text: ... she has been firing long-range beams repeatedly, making it impossible to leave the Monk's shield.

lines.speaker: johan
lines.text: We are trapped. We cannot advance.

lines.speaker: johan
lines.text: The Queen is simultaneously recovering and accumulating Raptures.

lines.speaker: johan
lines.text: The longer this continues, the slimmer our chances of survival.

lines.speaker: johan
lines.text: Eden's Spear will be ready in three hours.

lines.speaker: johan
lines.text: I don't expect the Queen will give us that long.

lines.speaker: papillon
lines.text: Then... what should we do?

lines.speaker: papillon
lines.text: Sh-shouldn't we retreat?

lines.speaker: johan
lines.text: That's one of the options.

lines.speaker: crown
lines.text: Retreat does not exist in my vocabulary.

lines.speaker: chime
lines.text: Aye! We may turn about and march onward, but retreat? 'Tis naught that I know!

lines.speaker: kilo
lines.text: Isn't that retreat...?

lines.speaker: snowwhite
lines.text: If we fall back now, who knows when we'll get another chance at the Queen?

lines.speaker: snowwhite
lines.text: Meanwhile, her forces will only grow stronger.

lines.speaker: hongryeon
lines.text: Yet now doth she suffer us not to draw nigh.

lines.speaker: hongryeon
lines.text: Upon the ground lie Raptures and Heretics. In the heavens abide the Queen and the Station.

lines.speaker: isabel
lines.text: An aerial approach is out of the question.

lines.speaker: isabel
lines.text: There are too many interception weapons, and they're all far too precise. Not even I could dodge them.

lines.speaker: isabel
lines.text: Over five Storm Bringers have been spotted. Approaching in a transport ship would be suicide.

lines.speaker: harran
lines.text: Johan, it seems we have no means left at our disposal.

lines.speaker: harran
lines.text: What do you intend to do, my Commander?

lines.speaker: marian_q
lines.text: I'll take the lead.

lines.speaker: marian_q
lines.text: I can withstand all of the Queen's attacks.

lines.speaker: marian_q
lines.text: You can form up around me and advance slowly...

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: Yet do Heretics and Raptures abide, and thou alone, Young Lady Marian, canst not withstand the multitude of those automated interception armaments.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: Take heed of thy safety, Young Lady Marian. Should all go awry, thou alone must survive.

lines.speaker: marian_q
lines.text: There's no way I could...!

lines.speaker: johan
lines.text: We are abandoning Eden.

lines.speaker: papillon
lines.text: So... we're retreating?

lines.speaker: papillon
lines.text: Y-yeah, that's a good idea. No matter how important this place is, when it's time to retreat, you retreat...

lines.speaker: johan
lines.text: We'll overload Eden's main power source and trigger a self-destruction.

lines.speaker: johan
lines.text: Everything within 10 km will be reduced to rubble.

lines.speaker: johan
lines.text: We'll lure them in as close as possible, and then detonate.

lines.speaker: johan
lines.text: Then we'll leave the rest up to him.

lines.speaker: isabel
lines.text: It seems that's the only way for now.

lines.speaker: harran
lines.text: Hmph, even a mere scratch would please me.

lines.speaker: papillon
lines.text: What... are you talking about? You want to lure them in and self-destruct?

lines.speaker: papillon
lines.text: Wh-who's supposed to do the luring? And what happens to the poor soul who actually does it?

lines.speaker: johan
lines.text: ... Inherit will lure them in. Feigning the launch of Eden's Spear is an option.

lines.speaker: johan
lines.text: The rest, withdraw at once.

lines.speaker: papillon
lines.text: I'll go. Nayuta, can I borrow that insanely fast camel of yours?

lines.speaker: papillon
lines.text: I'll go ask the Ark for support.

lines.speaker: papillon
lines.text: Sounds way better than blowing ourselves up, don't you think?

lines.speaker: johan
lines.text: We don't need the Ark's help.

lines.speaker: papillon
lines.text: What nonsense is that when we're about to die?! We have to survive first!

lines.speaker: johan
lines.text: There are things more important than mere survival.

lines.speaker: papillon
lines.text: Would you cut it out with that crazy talk? What could possibly matter more than staying alive?

lines.speaker: johan
lines.text: There is.

lines.speaker: papillon
lines.text: There's no way something like that exists...!

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: Young Hero Johan,

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: there remains another course.

lines.speaker: johan
lines.text: That is not an option.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: This humble one knows not how often these words have been spoken unto thee, Young Hero Johan, yet once more shall they be uttered.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: I... nay,

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: we...

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: shall do whatsoever is needed to prevail.
